core_obligations: Etale localize on X' to reduce the cartesian square to schemes.
Identify the localized comparison map with the schemes comparison map.

proof_roadmap.step: Etale-localize the square down to schemes.
Apply the schemes conormal-algebra flat base change result.

difficulty_reason: In a cartesian square of algebraic spaces with immersions i : Z -> X and i' : Z' -> X', the canonical map f^* C_{Z'/X',*} -> C_{Z/X,*} of graded conormal algebras is surjective, and an isomorphism when g : X -> X' is flat. The retained proof states its reduction explicitly: the assertion can be checked after etale localization on X', which brings the square to a morphism of schemes where all four terms are schemes' conormal algebras, and the schemes case from the Divisors chapter then gives both the surjectivity and the flat isomorphism. Retained author proof at lines 786-792.
